title: MOST POWERFUL MORNING PRAYERS THAT SILENCE EVERY VOICE OF DARKNESS
text: Hallelujah. Glory to God. If you are connected to this service right now, I want you to do something. I want you to share this message. Share it on your WhatsApp status. Share it on your Facebook. Send it to someone who is going through a difficult season. You do not know what the Lord is about to do through this word. The Bible says that faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. Romans chap 10 17. Someone's life is about to change tonight. Someone's destiny is about to shift, but the Lord needs a vessel. Will you be that vessel? Will you be the one to carry this fire to nations? Share this message. The Lord will use you as an instrument of deliverance. Your obedience might be the key that unlocks someone's breakthrough. Don't just listen and keep it to yourself. Spread the fire. Spread the glory. Let the whole earth be filled with the knowledge of the Lord. Oh, we worship you tonight, Lord. We worship you ancient of days. You are the one who was, who is, and who is to come. We give you praise. [music] We give you honor. We give you glory. There is none like you. There is none beside you. You alone are worthy of our praise. Yah Yahweh, you are Yahweh. You are the Lord of hosts. You are the commander of the armies of heaven. You are the one who makes a way where there is no way. You are the one who opens doors that no man can shut. You are the one who shuts doors that no man can open. We worship you tonight. We honor your name. Listen carefully. I want you to pay attention to what the spirit of God is about to reveal tonight. There is a reason you are connected to this service. There is a reason you are awake at this hour. There is a reason heaven orchestrated this moment. Nothing in the kingdom happens by accident. The very fact that you are hearing the sound of my voice right now is evidence that God has an appointment with your destiny. Tonight we are dealing with a very powerful subject. We are dealing with morning prayers that silence every voice of darkness. Let me give you the foundation from scripture. Go with me to the book of Psalm 5:es 1:3. The Bible says, "Give ear to my words, O Lord. Consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and [music] my God. For unto thee will I pray. My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Did you see that? David said, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning." The morning is not just a time of the day. The morning is a spiritual gate. The morning is a portal. The morning is a dimension of warfare that many believers have not understood. Now let me take you to another scripture. Mark 1 35. The Bible says, "And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." Who is the he? The Bible is talking about Jesus, the son of God, the word made flesh, the one who has all power in heaven and on earth. Yet he understood the mystery of the morning. He rose before daylight. He went to a solitary place and there he prayed. If Jesus needed to pray in the morning, how much more you and I? There are dimensions to this that the church has not explored. There are territories in the spirit that can only be accessed when you wake up before the sun rises. There are principalities that can only be displaced when you engage them in the morning hour. There are voices that have been speaking against your life, against your family, against your destiny. And tonight by the authority of the risen Christ, we are going to silence every one of them. What is a voice? Listen carefully. A voice is not just a sound. A voice is an instruction. A voice is a decree. A voice is a command. In the realm of the spirit, voices are constantly speaking. [music] The question is which voice are you listening to? And more importantly, which voice is prevailing over your life? In the book of Genesis chapter 1, we see that creation came by a voice. God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. God said, "Let there be a firmament." And there was a firmament. God said, "Let the dry land appear." And it appeared. Everything that exist was spoken into existence [music] by a voice. But there is another voice. A voice of darkness. A voice that speaks contrary to the will of God. A voice that speaks death when God has spoken life. A voice that speaks failure when God has spoken success. A voice that speaks baroness when God has spoken fruitfulness. A voice that speaks poverty when God has spoken abundance. This voice operates through many channels. It operates through witchcraft. It operates through familiar spirits. It operates through ancestral covenants. It operates through evil altars. It operates through the kingdom of darkness. And I have come to announce to someone tonight, the voice that has been speaking against your destiny will be silenced. The voice that said you will not marry will be silenced. The voice that said you will never prosper will be silenced. The voice that said that sickness will be your portion will be silenced. The voice that said your family will never know peace will be silenced by the power of the blood of Jesus. I decree and declare, let every voice of darkness be silenced now. Say it with me. Say, every voice of darkness, >> every voice >> speaking against my life, be silenced now in the name of Jesus. Say it like you mean it. Hallelujah. Now, let me teach you something. The morning is a strategic time for spiritual warfare because of what the Bible calls the morning watch. In Exodus chapter 14 vers 24, the Bible says, "And it came to pass that in the morning watch, the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud and troubled the host of the Egyptians." Did you see that? It was in the morning watch that God troubled the Egyptians. It was in the morning watch that the enemy was confused. It was in the morning watch that deliverance came. The Egyptians represent every force that has held you in bondage. The Egyptians REPRESENT EVERY POWER THAT HAS KEPT you in slavery. The Egyptians represent every voice that has been speaking limitation over your life. But tonight I prophesy the God who troubled the Egyptians in the morning watch WILL TROUBLE EVERY POWER troubling your destiny. EVERY PHARAOH THAT HAS REFUSED to let you go will be judged. EVERY TASKMASTER THAT HAS been oppressing your life will be destroyed. Every chain that has BEEN HOLDING YOU BACK will be broken. There is a DIMENSION OF PRAYER THAT happens in the morning that cannot be replicated at any other time. There is an anointing that is available at dawn that is not available at noon. There is a grace that is released when you wake up before the sun that positions you for supernatural dominion. This is why the enemy fights your sleep. This is why the enemy makes you tired at night. This is why the enemy keeps you up late watching things that do not profit your spirit. He does not want you to rise in the morning. He does not want you to engage him at the gate of the day. He does not want you to establish divine order before the activities of the day begin. But I prophesy to someone tonight, the grace to rise early will come upon you. The grace to pray in the morning will come upon you. The grace to engage heaven at the gate of the day will come upon you. Let me show you something from the book of Isaiah chapter 50 4. The Bible says, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the learned that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth mine ear to hear as the learned." Did you hear that? He wakenth morning by morning. God wakes you up every morning for a purpose. He wakes you up to hear his voice. He wakes you up to receive instructions. He wakes you up to access the dimension of the learned. But when you rise in the morning and you pray, you silence those voices. You cancel their decrees. You anol their instructions. You disrupt their operations. You establish the council of God over your day. The Bible says in the book of Lamentations 3:es 22 to 23, it is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. Did you hear that? His mercies are new every morning. Every morning there is fresh mercy available. Every morning there is fresh grace available. Every morning there is fresh power available. But you have to access it through prayer. If you sleep through the morning, you miss the fresh supply. If you are too tired to rise, you miss the new mercies. If you allow the cares of life to keep you in bed, you forfeit the portion that was allocated for that day. This is why Jesus rose a great while before day. He understood the principle. He knew that the morning was the gate of divine visitation. He knew that the morning was the portal of supernatural encounter. And tonight I am releasing that same grace upon your life. I am imparting that same discipline into your spirit. [music] I am speaking to your body. You will no longer be a slave to sleep. I am speaking to your mind. You will no longer be a captive to weariness. I am speaking to your spirit. You will rise with the expectation of divine encounter. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, there is a grace being released tonight, a grace to prevail, a grace to overcome, a grace to silence every voice that has been speaking against your [music] destiny. Lift your hands right where you are. Father, I thank you for this revelation. I thank you for opening the eyes of your people. I thank you for what you are about to do in the lives of everyone connected to this service. Lord, release the grace to pray in the morning. Release the discipline to rise before [music] the sun. Release the anointing to engage heaven at the gate [music] of the day in the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. Amen. Now, let me go deeper. Let me show you how to silence these voices of darkness. The first thing you must understand is that every voice has a source. No voice speaks by itself. Behind every voice is a spirit. Behind every spirit is an altar. Behind every altar is a covenant. If you want to silence a voice, you must deal with the altar. If you want to silence an altar, you must break the covenant. If you want to break the covenant, you must engage in targeted warfare. This is not general prayer. This is not routine prayer. This is strategic targeted prophetic warfare. In the book of Numbers 23 8, Balam said, "How shall I cause whom God had not cursed?" Or, "How shall I defy whom the Lord had not defied?" Did you hear that? Balam was a prophet for hire. He was paid to cause Israel. But when he opened his mouth, he could not cause them. Why? Because the voice of God over Israel was stronger than the voice of Balac's altar. There is a voice that speaks from the altar of God. And there is a voice that speaks from the altar of darkness. When the voice of God prevails, destiny is established. When the voice of darkness prevails, destiny is disrupted. Tonight, we are going to ensure that the voice of God prevails over your life. In the book of Zechariah chapter 3, we see a powerful example. The high priest Joshua was standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan was standing at his right hand to resist him. Satan was there to accuse. Satan was there to condemn. Satan was there to hinder. But look at what the Lord said in verses two. And the Lord said unto Satan, "The Lord rebuked thee, oh Satan. Even the Lord that had chosen Jerusalem rebuked thee. Is not this a brand plucked out of the fire. The Lord rebuked the accuser. The Lord silenced the voice of opposition. The Lord established his word over the life of Joshua. And tonight, the same thing will happen in your life. Every voice accusing you before the throne of God will be silenced. Every voice reminding heaven of your past sins will be silenced. Every voice presenting a case against your destiny will be silenced. I decree and declare, let the voice of the accuser be silenced now in the name of Jesus. Say it with me. Say every accusing voice be silenced in Jesus' name. Hallelujah. There is another dimension to this. In the book of Judges chapter 7, we see the story of Gideon. God reduced his army from 32,000 to 300. And with those 300 men, Gideon went to fight the Medidianites. But look at what happened in verses 20. The Bible says, "And the three companies blew the trumpets and break the pitchers and held the lambs in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands to blow with all. And they cried the sword of the Lord and love Gideon." They cried. They released a voice. They made a decree. They established dominion through their words. And what happened? The Bible says, "The Lord set every man's sword against his fellow throughout all the host." The enemy began to fight against themselves. The enemy began to destroy themselves. The enemy was thrown into confusion by the voice of Gideon's army. Tonight, I prophesy every enemy of your destiny will be thrown into confusion. Every power gathered against your life will begin to fight against themselves. EVERY CONSPIRACY OF DARKNESS will collapse by its own weight. The voice of the Lord is powerful. Psalm 29:es 4 says, "The voice of the Lord is powerful." The voice of the Lord is full of majesty. And when you carry the voice of the Lord in your mouth, you carry power. When you carry the voice of the Lord in your mouth, you carry majesty. When you carry the voice of the Lord in your mouth, you become dangerous to the kingdom of darkness. The devil is not afraid of your tears, the devil is not afraid of your complaints. The devil is not afraid of your depression. The devil is afraid of your voice. He is afraid of what comes out of your mouth when you align with heaven. This is why the enemy tries to silence believers. He tries to make you feel like your prayers don't work. He tries to make you feel like God is not listening. He tries to make you feel like your situation is hopeless. Because if he can silence your voice, he can control your destiny. But I have come to remind you, your voice is a weapon. Your voice is a sword. Your voice is a fire. Your voice is a hammer that breaks rocks in pieces. Jeremiah 23 29 says, "Is not my word like as a fire, saith the Lord, and like a hammer that breakth the rock in pieces?" When you speak the word of God, you release fire. When you speak the word of God, you release a hammer. You break every rock that has been placed on your path. YOU BURN EVERY obstacle that has been standing in your way. Are you ready to pray? I said, are you ready to pray? Because tonight we are going to silence every voice of darkness that has been speaking [music] against your life. We are going to close every gate of hell that has been opened against your family. Rise to your feet. I want you to raise your voice to heaven. Not a whisper, not a mmo, a voice, a cry, a roar. The Bible says in Joel 3 16, "The Lord also shall roar out of Zion and utter his voice from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth shall shake." When God speaks, the heavens and the earth shake. And when you speak as a representative of God, when you speak as an ambassador of the kingdom, when you speak as one who carries the authority of heaven, things will shake. The situation that refused to move will shake. The mountain that refused to relocate WILL SHAKE. THE GIANT that refused to fall will shake. Lift your voice right now and say, "Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the authority you have given me. I thank you for the power in your word. I thank you for the privilege to speak as your representative on the earth. Pray that prayer for one minute. Thank him for the authority he has given you. Hallelujah. Now listen to me. Listen carefully. The Bible says in the book of Revelation 12 11 and they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony and they love not their lives unto the death. They overcame who? The accuser, the voice of the enemy. They overcame him by two things. The blood of the lamb and the word of their testimony. The blood speaks. Hebrews 12 24 says that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. The blood of Abel cried out for vengeance, but the blood of Jesus cries out for mercy. The blood of Jesus cries out for forgiveness. The blood of Jesus cries out for redemption. When you plead the blood of Jesus, you are releasing a voice. A voice that silences every other voice. A voice that cancels every cause. A voice that nullifies every accusation. Are you hearing what I'm saying? And then the word of your testimony, your mouth, your voice, what you speak, what you declare, what you decree. When you combine the blood of Jesus with the word of your testimony, you become unstoppable. You become invincible. You become a force that hell cannot resist. I want you to lift your right hand toward heaven right now. We're about to enter into warfare. I want you to pray this prayer with every fiber of your being. Say, "Father, in the name of Jesus, I plead the blood of Jesus over my life. [music] I plead the blood of Jesus over my family. I plead the blood of Jesus over my destiny. I plead the blood of Jesus over my finances. I plead the blood of Jesus over my health. I plead the blood of Jesus over my ministry. I plead the blood of Jesus over my marriage. I plead the blood of Jesus over my children. Let the voice of the blood speak on my behalf. Let the voice OF THE BLOOD SILENCE EVERY ACCUSER. LET THE VOICE OF THE BLOOD cancel every cause. LET THE VOICE OF THE BLOOD ANOL every evil covenant. LET THE VOICE OF THE BLOOD CLOSE EVERY GATE OF HELL THAT HAS been opened [music] against me in the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. Pray it with passion. Pray it with fire. Pray it with authority. Hallelujah. Now I want you to target specific areas of your life. First we are going to deal with voices speaking against your destiny. There are voices that have been programmed against your destiny from the foundation of the world. Voices that were spoken at your birth. Voices that were spoken over your bloodline. Voices that were spoken [music] through evil dedication. Voices that were spoken through witchcraft initiation. Voices that were spoken THROUGH ANCESTRAL COVENANT. THESE voices have been following you from generation to generation. They are the reason why PATTERNS OF FAILURE HAVE PERSISTED in your family. They are the reason why certain blessings have eluded your lineage. They are the reason why progress has been slow and painful. But tonight, we are breaking the cycle. We are silencing those voices. We are establishing a new order. In the book of Ezekiel chapter 37, the Lord told the prophet to prophesy. He said, "Prophesy upon these bones and say unto them, oh ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord." The bones were dead. The bones were dry. The bones WERE SCATTERED. BUT WHEN THE VOICE OF the prophet was released, life came. When the word of the Lord was spoken, resurrection happened. I want you to prophesy to your destiny right now. Raise your voice and say, "I speak to my destiny. I command you to come alive. I command you to rise from the dead. I COMMAND EVERY SCATTERED BONE TO COME TOGETHER. I COMMAND EVERY DRY place to receive moisture. I COMMAND EVERY DEAD DREAM TO RESURRECT. EVERY VOICE THAT has spoken death over my destiny, I silence YOU NOW. EVERY VOICE THAT HAS SPOKEN FAILURE OVER MY PURPOSE, I SILENCE YOU NOW. EVERY VOICE THAT HAS SPOKEN LIMITATION OVER MY POTENTIAL, I silence you now and I decree that the voice of God prevails over my life. I decree that the counsel of God is established concerning me. I decree that the purpose of God for my life will be fulfilled in the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer for 2 minutes. Prophesy to your destiny. Speak life where death has been spoken. Speak success where failure has been decreed. Speak fulfillment where frustration has been programmed. Oh, I hear the sound of something breaking. [music] I hear the sound of chains falling off. I hear the sound of prison doors opening. Someone under the sound of my voice, your destiny has been locked in a prison for years. But tonight, the prison doors are opening. Tonight, the chains are falling off. Tonight you are walking free. Hallelujah. Now we're going to deal with voices speaking against your family. This is very [music] important. Many families are under siege because of voices that were spoken generations ago. Evil covenants that were made by ancestors. [music] Dedications that were done without knowledge. Sacrifices that were offered to idols. These voices continue to speak. They speak division. They speak divorce. They speak death. They speak disease. [music] They [singing] speak poverty. They speak madness. But the blood of Jesus is more powerful than any ancestral voice. The word of God is stronger than any generational cause. In the book of Colossians chapter 2 14-15, the Bible says, "Blottting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shoe of them openly, triumphing over them in it." Did you hear that? Jesus blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us. He nailed it to the cross. He spoiled principalities [singing] and powers. He made a public spectacle of them. This means that every voice that was written against your family has been blotted out. Every curse that was pronounced has been nailed to the cross. Every principality that has been assigned against your lineage has been spoiled. But you have to enforce this victory through prayer. You have to appropriate this triumph through declaration. Lift your voice right now and pray. In the name of Jesus, I cancel every evil voice speaking against my family. I break every curse that has been passed down two generations. I annol every covenant that was made by my ancestors with the kingdom of darkness. The handwriting of ordinances against my family is blotted out. It is nailed to the cross of Christ. It has no power over me. It has no power over my spouse. It has no power over my children. It has no power over my parents. It has no power over my siblings. I decree that my family is covered by the blood of Jesus. I decree that my family is protected by the angels of God. I decree that my family is established by the word of God. Every altar speaking against my family, catch fire. Every voice rising from the grave against my family, be silenced. Every inherited pattern of failure, break now. Every generational cycle of poverty, break now. EVERY ANCESTRAL pattern of sickness, break now. Every bloodline cause break now in the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. Pray it with fire. Pray it with authority. Pray it with violence in the spirit. [music] The kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. Matthew 11 12. Tonight be violent in your prayers. Take your family back by force. Reclaim your household from the grip of the enemy. Hallelujah. I decree peace in my marriage. I decree love in my marriage. I decree faithfulness in my marriage. I decree understanding in my marriage. I decree prosperity in my marriage. I decree fruitfulness in my marriage. My marriage will not fail. My marriage will not crumble. My marriage will not become a statistic. My marriage will be a testimony of God's grace and power in the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. I am covered by the blood. I am filled with the spirit. I am empowered by grace. I am established by the word. This week I will testify. This month I will celebrate. This year I will rejoice. This season I will triumph in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Hallelujah. Father, we thank you. We thank you for what you have done tonight. We thank you for what you are doing. We thank you for what you will do. We give you all the praise. We give you all the honor. We give you all the glory. Seal this work by your spirit. Protect this work by your power. Establish this work by your word. Let every life connected to this service experience the manifestation of everything that has been spoken in Jesus' name we pray. Amen. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you now and forever more. Go in peace. Walk in victory. Live in blessing. You are free in Jesus' name. Amen. Hallelujah.
